description: This file contains test cases for functions related to normalizing and formatting outbound payloads and reply payloads in a messaging system. It uses the Vitest testing framework and tests functions like normalizeReplyPayloadsForDelivery, normalizeOutboundPayloadsForJson, normalizeOutboundPayloads, and formatOutboundPayloadLog.

methods.name: normalizeReplyPayloadsForDelivery
methods.description: Normalizes reply payloads for delivery by parsing directives, merging media, and handling reply metadata.

methods.name: normalizeOutboundPayloadsForJson
methods.description: Converts outbound payloads into a JSON-compatible format, suppressing reasoning payloads and extracting media directives.

methods.name: normalizeOutboundPayloads
methods.description: Normalizes outbound payloads, handling channel data-only payloads and applying special formatting for BTW replies.

methods.name: formatOutboundPayloadLog
methods.description: Formats outbound payloads into a log-friendly string with media links.

ctags.name: channelData
ctags.pattern: /^    const channelData = { line: { flexMessage: { altText: "Card", contents: {} } } };$/
